t: You're in Emslie Horniman's Pleasance, a park in Kensal Town, in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. It opened in 1914 and is named after the man who created it, Emslie John Horniman, the MP for Chelsea. He was also an anthropologist and philanthropist. Today the park is best known as the traditional starting point for the Notting Hill Carnival.
